programme.desc: Víctor ayuda a Mónica con el encargo, y Leonor es la sospechosa de la muerte del Güero. Aurelio culpa a Rutila por el secuestro de Luzma, mientras Ignacio descubre que es hija de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luzma le dice a sus amigos que su papá los va a rescatar, mientras que Morejón se entera de que Luciana es amiga de la hija de Aurelio. Leonor enfrenta a Tim: lo acusa de la muerte del Güero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas llega al lugar donde mataron a Richie, mientras Luzma ruega a los secuestradores que negocien con su papá. El Chema y el Toro descubren que Julia es la esposa de Tim y deciden matarla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El secuestrador hace que Marcado vaya por Luzma, a cambio de trabajar con Aurelio. Rutila se entera de que su hermanita consume metanfetaminas. Morejón le pide a Rivero que retome su cargo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio rescata a Luzma y se enfrenta a Marcado, pero el violador de Rutila escapa. Padre e hija viajan a Michoacán, al rancho de Feyo. Morejón deja en manos de Rivero la rendición de los Emes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Belén se aman con pasión, mientras doña Alba cae en los brazos de Feyo. La hija y el yerno de Aguilera descubren la infidelidad. Morejón se entera de que Casillas liberó a los muchachos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Toro le dispara a Julia, quien muere en los brazos de Tim. Leonor escucha que la asesinaron para vengar al Güero y acusa a Rawlings. Rutila desespera y decide ir a la guerra contra el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema impide a la fuerza que Rutila escape con su hijo, mientras Víctor promete no dejar sola a su prima. Feyo y doña Alba siguen juntos, y Luzma le dice a Belén que está enamorada de su papá.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo llega al rancho, y su hija le dice que Belén le monta cuernos con Aurelio. Casillas pide luz verde a Rutila para matar al Chema; también le da pautas a Tim para vengar la muerte de Julia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo estalla de la rabia; le tiende una trampa a Belén para que vaya a casa de Justino y, delante de Aurelio, la amenaza de muerte. Ignacio le pide ayuda a Leonor para liberar a su asistente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo degüella y manda a enterrar a Belén ante los ojos de Aurelio, y le exige que pida perdón por ensuciar a la mujer que amaba. Casillas se va con Luzma de Michoacán tras la amenaza de Aguilera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que no lo quiere ver más, y él les propone a ella y a Esperanza que hagan una despedida los tres. Feyo dice en su rancho que Belén no regresará y prohíbe hablar de ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Morejón tiene problemas de bebida, y su esposa y colaboradores están preocupados. Aurelio sufre un fuerte dolor por deficiencia renal. Mónica negocia con Esperanza a espaldas de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor y Mónica hacen el amor; él no olvida a Chabela, pero quiere que lo ayude a no pensar en ella. Aurelio y Tim buscan un culpable del asesinato de Andrews, y Rivero detiene a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cristina, drogada, entra a la fuerza a casa de Víctor, donde Mónica la enfrenta. Furiosa, la periodista le dice a Rutila que se vengará. Leonor no resistiría estar de nuevo presa, y Omar le propone huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Desesperada, Mónica le pide ayuda a Omar para huir con su hijo, luego de confesarle a doña Alba que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel. Morejón acusa a Ignacio del atentado a Monteverde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba reconoce que Aurelio es un criminal y está decidida a matarlo. Leonor se enfrenta a tiros con Mónica frente al edificio de Omar. Feyo y Casillas viajan a Cancún, dispuestos a vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El secuestrador hace que Marcado vaya por Luzma, a cambio de trabajar con Aurelio. Rutila se entera de que su hermanita consume metanfetaminas. Morejón le pide a Rivero que retome su cargo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana exige que Iván le pague salarios atrasados y reconozca la paternidad de su hijo. David quiere enterrar juntas a su madre y a la esposa de esta, pero la directora del cementerio no lo permite.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonella pide ayuda psicológica para su esposo, su trabajo lo convirtió en un hombre violento. Luisa se casa con Javier, él le ofrece los papeles, pero oculta su pasado como narcotraficante.
programme.sub-title: Boxeador desmemoriado; Ciudadanía en cuestión por droga

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Miller quiere anular su matrimonio con José, tiene ébola y lo ocultó, además vende su sangre infectada. Luis demanda a su exnovia, ella le complicó la vida al acusarlo de forzarla a tener sexo.
programme.sub-title: Ébola mortal; Ley en California: Sí significa sí

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Angélica descubre que su esposo y padre de su niña es un depredador sexual, pide el divorcio. Antonio pierde a su hijo cuando la madre desaparece, ahora le exige a su ex cuñada que lo devuelva.
programme.sub-title: "Depredador" en Halloween; Adopta, mi hijo no

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sueña con someterse a una cirugía plástica que le permita lucir igual que una muñeca. Florencia es joven, bella y de buen corazón, pero no es feliz; su cuerpo despide un olor nauseabundo.
programme.sub-title: La muñeca mujer maravilla; Olor a pescado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana está enganchada a los selfies, su esposo la demanda, por su vicio, ya no tienen sexo. Tatiana pide la custodia de su sobrino, la madre está presa y su excuñado no es el padre biológico.
programme.sub-title: Mucho selfie, poco sexo; Estoy en el certificado, es mío

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roberto es profesor y demanda a la madre de su novia, cuando ella descubrió la relación le dio una paliza. Victoria le exige a la amante de su marido que devuelva los bienes que él le entregó.
programme.sub-title: Profesor golpeado; Novia de ella y amante de la momia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jean quiere abortar, grabar el procedimiento y comercializar el video. Sofia, su ex, se opone. Killer acaba de salir de prisión y le exige a Fabiana, su excuñada, que le devuelva a sus gemelas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Catalina recibe fotos donde su jefe le muestra el miembro, ella lo denuncia y él la demanda. Además, Yassiri exige la custodia de las hijas de Jonathan, él es esquizofrénico y puede ser peligroso.
programme.sub-title: Fotos del miembro; Viudo esquizofrénico con custodia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mayra exige que su actual pareja le devuelva el dinero que le entregó porque necesita ayudar a su hijo. Rosa pide la custodia de su padre, su sobrina usa al abuelo para promocionar sus diseños.
programme.sub-title: Basta de indocumentados; Abuelo se pone vestido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Martín, dueño de un canal online, demanda a Ivana porque usó la plataforma para vender drogas. Karina le pide a su ex que no abandone a su niña —no es su hija biológica—, pero ella no lo sabe.
programme.sub-title: Renuncia en TV por marihuana; Padrastro no quiere niña, ella sí

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nazarena le exige a su marido que desaloje a la mujer que la abandonó a los tres años, su madre biológica. Jessica tiene 14 años y un bebé; los abuelos paternos le piden que entregue al niño.
programme.sub-title: No quiero a mi prostituta madre; Niña de 14 quiere su hijo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Celimar tiene 17 años y para sobrellevar su enfermedad en paz quiere que sus padres se separen. María se dedica a vivir la vida loca con el dinero de su esposo, desde que este cayó en coma.
programme.sub-title: 17 años con cáncer pide divorcio de padres; Casi viuda 51 expresivamente sexual

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lorena demanda a su marido, él tiene sexo con su suegra enferma, según dice, para ayudarla. Lorena nació sin vagina, por eso quiere usar el dinero que ha ahorrado con su esposo para operarse.
programme.sub-title: Suegra con Guillain Barre Syndrome; Sin vagina nací

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángel demanda a Estela, la madre de su hija de 12 años, y le exige que reconozca su paternidad, pero ella se niega, alega que la niña vivió un trauma y por eso rechaza a los homosexuales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rafael y Samanta son una pareja de acróbatas, ella quiere aceptar un nuevo trabajo, pero él no. Mariana inventa una terapia contra la eyaculación precoz usando mordiscos, ahora la acosan.
programme.sub-title: Pareja de un circo; Terapia de mordiscos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rosalba prohíbe la entrada de homosexuales a su restaurante, su hijo la demanda, no comparte sus ideas. Luis exige que Andrea interne a su hijo autista para protegerla, ella pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Victoria fue víctima de un juego de roles, su boda y su marido son falsos, la usaron para grabar un video. Johana exige que su cuñado asuma la paternidad de su bebé, la esposa de él se opone.
programme.sub-title: Juego de rol; Hija de mi hermano

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paco demanda a su expareja por plagio, alega que le robó una aplicación para encuentros de tríos. Bruno exige que su esposa Helena desaloje a su familia y a su ex, que los trajo sin avisarle.

programme.title: Caso Cerrado
programme.desc: Miembros de la iglesia católica debatirán los asuntos actuales que han surgido en los medios desde la controversia del Padre Alberto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El trabajo de Juan es calentar a los actores porno antes de grabar; su esposa quiere el divorcio. Andrés descubre que su hija es fruto de una infidelidad; quiere dejar a su esposa y a la niña.
programme.sub-title: Marido fluffer; Hija enferma de otro

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yudi abandona a su familia para ganar una competencia, su esposo le exige que se ocupe del niño. Loreta demanda a su esposa porque quiere someterse a un suicidio asistido e involucra a su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Que esposa regrese a Venezuela; Hijo sugiere eutanasia para mamá

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Julio quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo, la madre usa al niño para recaudar dinero en internet. Pablo e Iñaki contratan a una madre subrogada, ahora se divorcian y no saben qué hacer.
programme.sub-title: Niño con bola en cuello falsa; Adopción gay

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yenni exige la aprobación de su esposo para dar en adopción a su hija que tiene una grave malformación. Pedro demanda a su empleadora, quien lo incitó a masturbarse ante la cámara y luego lo despidió.
programme.sub-title: El hombre con la cabeza atrás; Fotos con orgasmos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marlene aprueba que los maestros porten armas, su esposo no, ella quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hija. Sasha pide la emancipación de sus gemelas, alega que ya no puede controlarlas.
programme.sub-title: Maestros armados; Gemelas de 17 casarse con tercero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Melissa es pintora y tiene nueve años, afirma que su padre la explota, quiere vivir con su abuela. Ana pide que sus cuñados se ocupen de su suegra, perdió la razón y ella no puede cuidarla.
programme.sub-title: Niña pintora, padre abusador; ¿Qué hacemos con María desnuda?

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana se casó con Juan, su suegro, para obtener la residencia. Además, una bebé murió ahogada por su hermana mayor. La madre culpa al padre porque, mientras ocurría la tragedia, el hombre estaba teniendo sexo con la niñera que debía cuidar a las niñas.
programme.sub-title: Me casé con suegro x papeles; Bebé muere asfixiada

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana Lola es dueña de un asilo de ancianos donde los residentes tienen sexo unos con otros. Beba necesita un trasplante de médula ósea para sobrevivir, pero no quiere a su madre como donante.
programme.sub-title: Asilo de viejos gozando; Beba no quiere medula de mamá

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: En casa de Yamileth inician un negocio ilegal de matar cerdos, teme que arresten a toda la familia. Laura es una mujer adulta con una extraña adicción: vivir como un bebé varias horas al día.
programme.sub-title: Mata puercos; Adicta a ser bebé

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángela crea un tratamiento para rejuvenecer y el principal ingrediente es sangre de ratas; su arrendador la demanda. David demanda a su esposa; descubrió que los gemelos que adoptó tienen sida.
programme.sub-title: Sangre de rata rejuvenece; Hijastros con sida

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Rebecca's new marriage to Daniel seems perfect, but she hides a lifelong secret-she can see and hear spirits. She has always blocked them out, but when a persistent ghost refuses to be ignored, she can no longer run. Forced to confront the entity, Rebecca must trust Daniel and enlist his help to uncover the truth before it threatens their new life together.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: As kids, Tim and Tom Yancey love playing in the Florida woods-until a menacing presence begins watching them. When it invades their bedroom, terror traps them in their own home. With no help in sight, the nightmare follows Tim into adulthood. Decades later, he returns to confront the demon that stole his childhood, determined to reclaim his life once and for all.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Deadly Attachment Georgia single Mom Cindy Sauer tries to get over the sudden death of her husband when dark shadows and nightmares convince her that a demon is haunting her and her family. Cindy turns to a Pastor to exorcise the entity before it drives them literally insane.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Victoria Dane of New Mexico awakens from a near-­death experience to discover she is being attacked by a dark, demonic entity. With the help of investigators, she soon realizes she has opened a door to a paranormal world that may never be shut.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits - one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After marrying Stephen, Angela's childhood nightmares return-only now, the old hag from her dreams appears in waking life. She dismisses it as anxiety until the entity terrorizes her daughter and briefly possesses her son. Realizing the threat is real, Angela, at Stephen's urging, turns to paranormal investigators to fight the relentless evil before it destroys their family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Judy McCarthy hopes for a fresh start in Texas, but a shadowy presence emerges in their home. It fixates on her teenage daughter, Caressa, tormenting her each night. As the entity grows stronger, Judy fights to protect her family. When she uncovers the home's violent past, she realizes the spirit is intent on keeping Caressa trapped-and she must act before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. After unseen entities attack her children, they seek out psychic investigators. As events grow violent, Bonnie forms a psychic link to the past, and investigators witness the haunting escalate from obsession to possession.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy's peaceful Alaskan retreat turns into a nightmare when their daughter unknowingly invites a dark entity through witchcraft. What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Michigan attorney Chris Gibbons and his family move into their dream house, which quickly becomes a nightmare. A bizarre combination of terrifying dreams and ghost sightings force Chris to do battle with the supernatural.
